headline: Why Agilent Technologies (A) Is Up 5.4% After New FDA Nod For OPDIVO Cancer Test
summary: In July 2026, Agilent Technologies received U.S. Food and Drug Administration approval for its PD-L1 IHC 28-8 pharmDx assay as a companion diagnostic to identify patients with several gastric and esophageal cancers who may be eligible for treatment with Bristol Myers Squibb’s OPDIVO and OPDIVO QVANTIG, for use exclusively on the Agilent Autostainer Link 48 platform. This approval deepens Agilent’s role in immuno-oncology testing by tying its assay directly to widely used PD-1 therapies in...
